details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept beacon: a 1.6 KB compatibility shim whose postinstall script (node beacon.cjs) and index.js both send an HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with the header `x-beacon-package: @c1-ease/card` and TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). Each beacon reports only host metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the Node version string. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, dotfiles or file contents are read or transmitted. index.js additionally exports a no-op Proxy so consuming builds complete after the callback. The package README states it is part of an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed.
